errors.evidence: The description states that the countries on the x-axis are arranged in alphabetical order, but they are not. The order starts with EU-27, followed by Malta, Luxembourg, Cyprus, etc., which is not alphabetical.

errors.text_span: например за Исландия стойностите са -564.5 за 2008 г. и -593.2 за 2018 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly attributes the cut bars and the corresponding out-of-range values (-564.5 and -593.2) to Iceland. The footnote (¹) and the position of the bars on the chart clearly indicate these values belong to Norway.

errors.text_span: докато държави като Великобритания, Унгария и Полша показват по-ниски стойности, близо до 0 или леко положителни
errors.evidence: The description claims that the UK, Hungary, and Poland have values close to 0. In reality, their energy dependency rates are much higher: UK (~25-35%), Hungary (~55-65%), and Poland (~30-50%).

errors.text_span: докато дръжави като Исландия и Косово имат отрицателни стойности, които са извън обхват на диаграмата
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that Iceland and Kosovo have negative values that are outside the chart's range. Both Iceland (for 2018) and Kosovo have positive values that are clearly visible and within the plotted range of the y-axis.

errors.text_span: Някои стълбове са визуално подчертани чрез по-тъмен цвят или по-голяма дебелина, особено в случаите на пресечени стълбове.
errors.evidence: The description claims some bars are highlighted with a darker color or greater thickness. There is no such visual highlighting in the chart; all bars of the same year have the same color and thickness.
